A clear sequence

From registration to dispatch, one approval at a time.

01 / REGISTERSubmit six waitlist details
02 / REVIEWOwner reviews carrier and trucks
03 / AGREEComplete written terms
04 / COORDINATECarrier controls each load decision
01

Register

The Founder Waitlist form records carrier name, authority, email, equipment, truck count, and telephone. A successful registration records founder eligibility; it is not an approval.

02

Review

The owner reviews each carrier and requested truck against eligibility and actual operating capacity. Submission alone does not guarantee acceptance or a start date.

03

Complete written terms

Before service, the carrier reviews the applicable written agreement, plan, and limited authorization. No electronic signature is represented on this website.

The carrier makes the load decision

Almajdoub Dispatch does not accept a load, sign a Rate Confirmation, or bind the carrier. The carrier reviews the specific offer and signs or returns its own Rate Confirmation.
